body:
# Lattice

*Vanilla, woven deeper.*

Lattice is a vanilla+ overhaul. Four modules add depth to systems Minecraft already does well — structural physics, craft quality, exploration recognition, and villager memory — without changing what vanilla already does well.

A player who installs Lattice and does nothing different still experiences a recognizable Minecraft. Lattice reveals itself when the player chooses to engage.


Note: If you have any bugs or want to give any sugguestions, please feel free to join our discord here, a github will be made soon:
[Discord](https://discord.gg/bfbK97Yez8)
---

## What's in it

### 🏗️ Loadbearing — *Structural integrity simulation*

Blocks have weight and lean. Bad cantilevers crack and fall.

Every tracked block lives in a hidden state machine: Stable → Stressed → Overloaded → Cracked → Failed. Build a 30-block stone cantilever and the unsupported end will accumulate stress, develop a visible crack, then fall. Add a support pillar in time, and the stress drains; the crack closes.

Six material classes — stone, wood, concrete, metal, masonry, fragile — each with their own load tolerance.

The **Stress Probe** (craftable) lets you inspect any tracked block's current state.

### 🛠️ Atelier — *Craft quality variation*

Every tool and armor piece rolls one of five tiers when you craft it:

| Tier | Probability | Durability |
|------|:-:|:-:|
| Crude | 10% | −20% |
| Plain | 50% | ±0% |
| Sound | 25% | +10% |
| Fine | 12% | +25% |
| Pristine | 3% | +50% |

Lore on every item shows its tier and effect. Fine and Pristine armor get unique names — a *Pristine Diamond Chestplate* announces itself in your inventory.

Covers all 30 craftable tools and 20 armor pieces. **130 quality variants in total.**

### 🧭 Wayfare — *Exploration progression*

Time in biomes and discovery of structures grant lasting attunements.

**Six biome categories**, each granting context-appropriate effects while you're there:
- Forest → Speed
- Desert → Saturation
- Ocean → Water Breathing
- Cave → Night Vision
- Taiga → Resistance
- Mountain → Slow Falling

**Seven structure attunements** earned by discovering villages, ocean monuments, mansions, ancient cities, trial chambers, end cities, and nether fortresses.

The **Way Compass** (craftable) scans nearby biome categories you haven't yet attuned to, pointing you toward what's new.

### 🏛️ Renown — *Villager memory*

Villagers remember. Trade with them, cure their zombies, attack their kind — they remember.

A single score from −100 to +100, with six tiers from Hated to Revered. Trading earns reputation; killing villagers costs it; first contact grants a welcoming +5 boost. Reputation decays toward zero over real time — a single mistake is recoverable; a sustained pattern persists.

Crossing a tier boundary plays a chime and shows a title — *"Welcomed: You are welcome here"* — or, in the other direction, *"Mistrusted: They no longer trust you."*

---

## The Lattice Codex

A carryable book item that opens Lattice's menu from inside the game world. Right-click it to view your progress across all four modules at once.

Craftable from 6 books + 2 iron ingots + 1 carrot-on-a-stick.

---

## Installation

Lattice ships as **two parts** — a datapack and a resource pack. You need both.

1. Drop the **datapack** zip into your world's `datapacks/` folder.
2. Drop the **resource pack** zip into your Minecraft `resourcepacks/` folder.
3. Launch the world. In game: **Options → Resource Packs → enable Lattice**.

**Uninstalling**: Run `/function lattice:uninstall` first to remove scoreboards, storage, and tags. Then remove the packs. Lattice ships no worldgen — removal leaves no permanent changes to your world.

---

## First Steps

When you first install Lattice:

- Hit **Escape** — *Lattice* now appears as a pause-screen button. Browse the four module pages.
- Build something tall. Try a cantilever. Watch what happens when it crosses Loadbearing's threshold.
- Craft a tool. Read the lore. That's Atelier's tier roll.
- Travel somewhere new. Two minutes (alpha threshold) and you'll be attuned.
- Trade with a villager. Your first trade gives a +5 boost — enough to push you out of Stranger immediately.

Lattice rewards engagement. None of this is required. Vanilla still works exactly as it did.

---

## Configuration

Every module can be enabled or disabled independently. **Pause menu → Lattice → Modules → [module name] → Toggle Module On/Off.**

Disabling a module preserves all of its state. Re-enabling restores everything where you left it.

There is no command-line admin interface — configuration is intentionally through the dialog menu.

---

## Compatibility

- **Minecraft Java Edition** 1.21.11 and 26.1.1 (tested)
- Single-player and dedicated server
- Datapack format 94-120; resource pack format 75-100
- May work on other versions within the format range — untested
- Should coexist with most cosmetic packs

---

## Status

**Lattice v1.0.0-alpha** — Feature-complete. Architecture stable. Seeking playtest feedback.

A small number of features wait on Minecraft 26.2 schema clarifications — per-profession Renown, iron golem hostility at low Renown, and non-fatal attack tracking. These will land in a later release.
